attempts.cause: The quarter_of function in FISCAL_CALENDAR incorrectly calculates the fiscal quarter based on the fiscal year starting July 1st.
attempts.candidate:
create or replace package body fiscal_calendar as
  function year_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    return extract(year from p_date) + case when extract(month from p_date) >= 7 then 1 else 0 end;
  end year_of;

  function quarter_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    -- Fiscal quarters:
    -- Q1: July, Aug, Sep (Months 7, 8, 9)
    -- Q2: Oct, Nov, Dec (Months 10, 11, 12)
    -- Q3: Jan, Feb, Mar (Months 1, 2, 3)
    -- Q4: Apr, May, Jun (Months 4, 5, 6)
    
    -- Adjust month to be 1-based relative to the fiscal year start (July = 1)
    -- If month is 1-6, month_in_fiscal_year = month + 7
    -- If month is 7-12, month_in_fiscal_year = month - 6
    
    -- A simpler way: map months 1-12 to fiscal quarters 1-4
    -- Months 7, 8, 9 -> Q1
    -- Months 10, 11, 12 -> Q2
    -- Months 1, 2, 3 -> Q3
    -- Months 4, 5, 6 -> Q4
    
    case extract(month from p_date)
      when 7 then return 1; -- July
      when 8 then return 1; -- August
      when 9 then return 1; -- September
      when 10 then return 2; -- October
      when 11 then return 2; -- November
      when 12 then return 2; -- December
      when 1 then return 3; -- January
      when 2 then return 3; -- February
      when 3 then return 3; -- March
      when 4 then return 4; -- April
      when 5 then return 4; -- May
      when 6 then return 4; -- June
      else return null; -- Should not happen
    end case;
  end quarter_of;
end fiscal_calendar;
/
